# Kumuditha Tharinda Liyanage

> Kumuditha Tharinda Liyanage is a software engineering student at NIBM in Sri Lanka and a full-stack developer who builds practical mobile, web, desktop, cloud and IoT software.

## Primary profile

- Website: https://tharinda.dev/
- GitHub: https://github.com/mr-kumuditha
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/kumudithaliyanage
- Contact: dev@tharinda.dev
- Location: Colombo, Sri Lanka
- Availability: Open to software engineering internships.

## Key projects

- [Navora](https://tharinda.dev/projects/navora): A Flutter travel application for Sri Lanka using Firebase AI Logic and Gemini for itinerary generation, OSRM for routing, and Overpass for place discovery.
- [Fixora](https://tharinda.dev/projects/fixora): A role-based native Android device repair and service-management platform built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Firebase, Supabase and SQLite.
- [MacPulse](https://tharinda.dev/projects/macpulse): A Swift and SwiftUI macOS menu-bar utility for real-time CPU, memory, disk, network and battery monitoring.
- [Ever After Wedding](https://tharinda.dev/projects/ever-after-wedding): A Java Spring Boot and MySQL wedding-management system for packages, inquiries, bookings, payments and reporting.
- [DevPilot Studio](https://tharinda.dev/projects/devpilot-studio): A POSIX shell CLI engine and Claude Code marketplace plugin for local session-usage and rate-limit monitoring.
